observations.text: Home is a prompt-first launcher: the agent input is the hero; recent projects and an inspiration grid sit below. No canvas is shown on home.

The same agent composer (testids agent-message-input / agent-input-bottom-more-button / agent-thinking-mode-button / agent-custom-settings-button / agent-send-button) reappears verbatim inside the canvas right panel — one composer component, two hosts.
Model preference popover lists 22 image, 20 video, 1 3D model with an ETA badge (10s–600s) and a 会员专属 (members-only) tag on most video models; 自动 toggle lets the agent pick.
Skill catalog has 6 categories and 19 named skills (e.g. Logo 设计, 分镜故事板, 一键跨平台适配, 室内设计). Skills are prompt-level recipes, selected from the composer, not tools on the canvas.

Clicking the Design chip rewrites the placeholder suggestions (e.g. 'Design a Bauhaus-inspired poster.'); chips are prompt presets, not model selectors, except GPT Image 2 / Seedance 2.0 / Nano Banana Pro which are model names.
Project cards open the canvas via window.open('/canvas?projectId=<32-hex>') — a new browser tab, not in-app navigation. Canvas route drops the /zh locale prefix.
Credits balance (⚡70) is shown in the top strip next to 升级; account is on the non-member tier (video models marked 会员专属).

Submitting a prompt from home creates a new project and opens the canvas with the agent running (placeholder copy + 新建项目 link both point to /canvas?newProject=true). Not executed from home to keep credit spend inside the scratch project.
Whether the countdown promo banner can be dismissed; what 试用 Lovart 新版本 switches (likely a separate app shell) — not entered.
